# Copilot instructions

Read every file in `.memory-bank/` before starting any task in this repository — `brief.md`,
`product.md`, `context.md`, `architecture.md`, `tech.md`, and `tasks.md`, in that order. This
is mandatory and applies to trivial tasks too.

Begin your first response with `[Memory Bank: Active]` once you have read them, or
`[Memory Bank: Missing]` if the folder is absent or empty.

The full protocol, working rules, and verification commands are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
